newsitem.title: JAPAN: MHI, Sega to discuss theme park amusements tie-up.
newsitem.headline: MHI, Sega to discuss theme park amusements tie-up.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd (MHI) said on Wednesday that it and video game firm Sega Enterprises Ltd would start negotiations over a possible tie-up to develop high-tech attractions for theme parks.
An MHI spokesman said the two firms were interested in combining MHI's hardware technology and Sega's software knowhow.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that the first cooperation between the two companies would be in interactive equipment being developed by MHI in space craft and aircraft simulators for which Sega would provide software.
MHI has diversified into the amusement-park business and is now constructing a theme park in Kaohsing, Taiwan, he said.
He said it was possible Sega might cooperate in the Kaohsing project.
